# Entity Quick Reference {#sec-entity-reference}

The entities that appear in typical mechanical files, with their attributes in file order (inherited attributes included, derived ones marked `*`) and the chapter where each is discussed.
Types in italics are supertypes that appear only inside complex instances.

## Header {#sec-entity-reference-header}

| Entity | Attributes, in order | Where |
|---|---|---|
| `FILE_DESCRIPTION` | description (list), implementation_level | @sec-header |
| `FILE_NAME` | name, time_stamp, author (list), organization (list), preprocessor_version, originating_system, authorization | @sec-header |
| `FILE_SCHEMA` | schema_identifiers (list) | @sec-header |

| Entity | Attributes, in order | Where |
|---|---|---|
| `APPLICATION_CONTEXT` | application | @sec-header, @sec-product-chain |

| `PRODUCT_CONTEXT` | name, frame_of_reference, discipline_type | @sec-product-chain |
| `PRODUCT_DEFINITION_CONTEXT` | name, frame_of_reference, life_cycle_stage | @sec-product-chain |
| `PRODUCT` | id, name, description, frame_of_reference (set) | @sec-product-chain |
| `PRODUCT_DEFINITION_FORMATION` | id, description, of_product | @sec-product-chain |
| `PRODUCT_DEFINITION_FORMATION_WITH_SPECIFIED_SOURCE` | id, description, of_product, make_or_buy | @sec-product-chain |
| `PRODUCT_DEFINITION` | id, description, formation, frame_of_reference | @sec-product-chain |
| `PRODUCT_RELATED_PRODUCT_CATEGORY` | name, description, products (set) | @sec-product-chain |
